signal: HSI launched Sky, an AI assistant for its EHS platform, partnered with Enhesa, and won a 2026 Environment + Energy Leader software award

email.body1:
Harold, saw HSI launch Sky, sign the Enhesa partnership, and win a 2026 Environment + Energy Leader award.

With that much momentum, the real bottleneck is usually signal-to-action latency: more in-market accounts surface than the team can route and work fast. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for HSI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Harold, quick follow-up for HSI.

Most sales-ops teams lose pipeline in the gap between a signal firing and a rep actually touching the account. That lag quietly caps conversion, and it rarely shows up cleanly in the numbers until the quarter is already tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change to cut that latency. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Harold, last bit of proof for HSI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how HSI's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Harold, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters off a launch and award season, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy for sales ops.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to HSI either way.
